- `Malicious`: do not swap

provider.description: Screening provider that produced this verdict.

- `DEPOSIT_DETECTED`: deposit seen, waiting for confirmations
- `EXCHANGE_IN_PROGRESS`: the swap is running
- `SENDING_TO_INTERMEDIARY`: private only: first leg on its way to the bridge token
- `REACHED_INTERMEDIARY`: private only: first leg done
- `INITIATING_SECOND_EXCHANGE`: private only: second leg starting

- `SENDING_TO_RECEIVER`: payout on its way to `receiverAddress`
- `SWAP_COMPLETED`: finished
- `EXPIRED`: no deposit arrived before `expires`
- `FAILED`: the swap could not complete; check `actionRequired`
- `REFUNDED`: funds returned to `refundAddress`
- `DELETED`: order removed

gasUsd.description: Estimated gas cost in USD. DEX routes only.

amountInUsd.description: `amountIn` valued in USD. Present on exact-out quotes only.

bridgeFeeUsd.description: Bridge fee in USD, when the route crosses chains.

- equals `amountOut` on CEX quotes, which carry no `feeUsd`
- gas is not deducted
- falls back to `amountOut` when the output token has no USD price

error.description: Why this route could not be priced. When set, the amounts are not usable.

filtered.description: True when the route was returned but should not be used. Check `filteredReason`. Creating an exchange from a filtered route is rejected.

filteredReason.description: Why the route was filtered: unacceptable price impact, or the payout wallet differs from the sender.

supportsSignatures.description: True when the route accepts EIP-712 permit signatures instead of a separate approval transaction.

markupSupported.description: True when the route can apply partner markup. Routes that cannot are excluded when you send `markup`.

slippageSupported.description: True when the route honours the `slippage` parameter.

apiMarkupValue.description: Markup the route was priced with, in the unit given by `markupType`.

restrictedCountries.description: ISO country codes where this route may not be offered.

rewardsAvailable.description: True when the swap earns rewards.

min.description: Smallest amount this route accepts, e.g. `0.001` BTC.

max.description: Largest amount this route accepts, e.g. `5` BTC.

minOut.description: Smallest amount you can receive, e.g. `100` USDT. Present only when `amountType` is `receive` and the provider returns receive-side bounds.

maxOut.description: Largest amount you can receive, e.g. `50000` USDT. Present only when `amountType` is `receive` and the provider returns receive-side bounds.

rateId.description: Identifies the locked rate on a fixed-rate quote. You do not pass this when creating the exchange. `quoteId` carries it.

fixed.description: True when the rate is locked until `validUntil`.

validUntil.description: When the locked rate expires, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, e.g. `"1767225600"`. Fixed-rate quotes only. Create the exchange before it passes.

requiresApproval.description: DEX quotes only. True when the wallet must approve the token before swapping. EVM and Tron non-native tokens. Call [Get token approval data](/api-reference/on-chain-dex-or-bridge/get-token-approval-data), send what it returns, then poll [Check token allowance](/api-reference/on-chain-dex-or-bridge/check-token-allowance) until it turns true.

depositAddressSupported.description: DEX quotes only. True when the route can be funded by sending to a deposit address, with no connected wallet.

requiresRefundAddress.description: True when this provider needs a `refundAddress` to execute. Collect one before creating the exchange; without it the swap falls through to the next provider.

appliedApiMarkup.description: The `markup` you sent, as a percentage (`0.5` = 0.5%), returned back so you can check it was used. Absent when your stored account markup applied. On a private swap this is the PER-LEG value and is charged on both legs.

refundAddress.description: The `refundAddress` you sent, returned back so you can check it was used. It sits on the source chain.

amountType.description: Whether the amounts are driven by the send side (`send`) or the receive side (`receive`).

SwapShortName.description: A provider's short code, e.g. `cl`. Get the current list from [Get swap providers](/api-reference/reference-data/get-swap-providers). The `shortName` field.

amount.description: Amount of the `from` token to swap, e.g. `1.5` BTC or `250.75` USDT, not base units / wei like `100000000000000`.

from.description: Token you are swapping from. Use an `id` from [Get tokens](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/get-tokens). A 24-character hex id such as `6689b73ec90e45f3b3e51566`, not a symbol like `ETH`.

to.description: Token you are swapping to. Use an `id` from [Get tokens](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/get-tokens). A 24-character hex id such as `6689b73ec90e45f3b3e51558`, not a symbol like `SOL`.

slippage.description: Slippage percentage. Only used for DEX swaps.

markup.description:
Markup for this request, as a percentage. `0.5` means 0.5%.

- range 0 to 4; overrides your account default for this trade
- send `0` for no markup, or omit the field to use your account default
- providers that cannot apply it are excluded from the results

useXmr.description: Use XMR if true, if false use another token for the anonymous transaction

fixed.description: Request a fixed-rate quote. Only partners that support fixed rate will be returned. Available for standard and private CEX quotes; not supported for DEX.

refundAddress.description:
Where funds are returned if a swap cannot complete. Optional here. Quotes are never filtered by it.

- **use a wallet the user controls, not an exchange deposit address**
- must be on the source chain: the refund comes back as the token you deposited
- a route that will need one comes back with `requiresRefundAddress: true`
- supply it at [Create exchange](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/create-exchange), where it is required for fixed-rate quotes and for those routes

deviationThreshold.description: Maximum price deviation percentage when rotating wallets. Only used if rotatePayoutWallets is true. Default 5

rotationLookback.description: Number of recent orders to check for path rotation. Only used if rotatePayoutWallets is true. Default 10

rotatePayoutWallets.description: Rotate the payout path for better privacy. Only used for private swaps (`types=private`). Standard and DEX are single-leg and ignore it.

rotateFallback.description: When strict rotation exhausts every rotated route, fall back to a valid non-rotated route instead of failing. Default false. Requires rotatePayoutWallets. A no-op on its own.

types.description: Types of quotes to return; if omitted, all types are used

swaps.description:
Only quote these providers. Omit to use all of them.

- values are `shortName` from [Get swap providers](/api-reference/reference-data/get-swap-providers)
- applies to every quote type: private, standard and DEX

inLegIncludedSwaps.description: Only use these providers for the in-leg of a private (2-hop) route. Ignored by standard and DEX quotes, which are single-hop.

inLegExcludedSwaps.description: Never use these providers for the in-leg of a private (2-hop) route. Does not affect the out-leg. Ignored by standard and DEX quotes.

outLegIncludedSwaps.description: Only use these providers for the out-leg of a private (2-hop) route. Ignored by standard and DEX quotes, which are single-hop.

outLegExcludedSwaps.description: Never use these providers for the out-leg of a private (2-hop) route. Does not affect the in-leg. Ignored by standard and DEX quotes.

senderAddress.description: Wallet that funds the swap, on the source chain. Used by DEX quotes only. Private and standard swaps ignore it.

receiverAddress.description:
Wallet that receives the payout.

- when it differs from `senderAddress`, DEX routes that cannot pay out to a different wallet are returned with `filtered: true` and `filteredReason: different_recipient`. Still listed, but not usable
- also used for payout wallet rotation

sort.description: Sort the quotes by the given field (default: amountOut)

amountType.description:
Whether `amount` refers to the send side or the receive side.
- `"send"` (default): amount is what the user sends. System computes what they receive.
- `"receive"`: amount is what the user wants to receive. System computes what they must send. Requires `fixed=true`. Available for standard and private CEX quotes; DEX quotes are dropped from the result, and a DEX-only request is rejected.

MultiQuoteMode.description:
Controls how many of the submitted orders are individually quoted.
- `all` (default): every order is quoted and returns its own array of candidate routes.
- `single`: only the first order is quoted; the remaining orders come back with `quoted: false` and no candidates. A lighter, faster preview for when quoting the whole batch is too slow.

message.description: What went wrong, in plain text. Show it, but do not branch on it. The wording can change.

code.description: Machine-readable reason, from the same set of codes as a top-level error response. Branch on this.

MultiQuoteOrderResult.description: Per-order quote result envelope; `quotes` is empty when `error` is set.

index.description: Index of this order in the request `orders` array.

quoted.description: False when the order was not individually quoted (single mode).

total.description: Number of candidate quotes returned for this order.

quotes.description: Routes for this order, best rate first. Empty when `quoted` is false or `error` is set.

error.description: Why this order could not be quoted. Only the affected order fails. The rest of the batch still returns, and the request is still a 200.

mode.description: The `mode` this batch was quoted with.

batched.description: The `batched` setting this request ran with.

orders.description: One entry per order you sent, in the same order. Match them up with `index`.

MultiQuoteOrderItem.description: A single order to quote within a POST /quotes/multi batch.

from.description: Token you are swapping from: an `id` from [Get tokens](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/get-tokens), e.g. `6689b73ec90e45f3b3e51566`.

to.description: Token you are swapping to: an `id` from [Get tokens](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/get-tokens), e.g. `6689b73ec90e45f3b3e51558`.

anonymous.description: Use anonymous (private) routing for this order.

useXmr.description: Force XMR as the anonymous bridge token.

Markup for this request, as a percentage. `0.5` means 0.5%.

- range 0 to 4; overrides your account default for this trade
- send `0` for no markup, or omit the field to use your account default
- providers that cannot apply it are excluded from the results

exclude.description: Never use these providers for this leg. Values are `shortName` from [Get swap providers](/api-reference/reference-data/get-swap-providers).

onlySwaps.description: Only quote these providers. Omit to use all of them. Values are `shortName` from [Get swap providers](/api-reference/reference-data/get-swap-providers).

rotatePayoutWallets.description: Rotate the payout path for better privacy. Private swaps only. Standard and DEX are single-leg and ignore it.

rotateFallback.description: When strict rotation runs out of rotated routes, use a valid non-rotated route instead of failing. Default false. Needs `rotatePayoutWallets`, on its own it does nothing.

deviationThreshold.description: How far the rate may move, as a percentage, before a rotated route is rejected. Default 5. Only used when `rotatePayoutWallets` is true.

rotationLookback.description: How many of your recent orders to look at when picking a different payout path. Default 10. Only used when `rotatePayoutWallets` is true.

inLeg.description: Provider filter for the in-leg of a private (2-hop) route. Omit it and `onlySwaps` applies to both legs. Ignored by standard and DEX, which are single-hop.

outLeg.description: Provider filter for the out-leg of a private (2-hop) route. Omit it and `onlySwaps` applies to both legs. Ignored by standard and DEX, which are single-hop.

orders.description: The swaps to quote, 1 to 10 per request. Each is quoted on its own, so one failing does not fail the rest.

filters.description: Provider filters applied to every order in the batch.

mode.description: How many of the submitted orders to quote. `all` (the default) quotes every order; `single` quotes only the first order and returns the rest with `quoted: false`. See MultiQuoteMode for the full behaviour.

tokens.description:
Ethereum is a global, open-source platform for decentralized applications. In other words, the vision is to create a world computer that anyone can build applications in a decentralized manner; while all states and data are distributed and publicly accessible. Ethereum supports smart contracts in which developers can write code in order to program digital value. Examples of decentralized apps (dapps) that are built on Ethereum includes tokens, non-fungible tokens, decentralized finance apps, lending protocol, decentralized exchanges, and much more.

On Ethereum, all transactions and smart contract executions require a small fee to be paid. This fee is called Gas. In technical terms, Gas refers to the unit of measure on the amount of computational effort required to execute an operation or a smart contract. The more complex the execution operation is, the more gas is required to fulfill that operation. Gas fees are paid entirely in Ether (ETH), which is the native coin of the blockchain. The price of gas can fluctuate from time to time depending on the network demand.

tags.name: Private and Standard Swaps
tags.description:
CEX swaps in two modes, sharing the same endpoints. Pick one with the `types` parameter.

- `types=standard`. Direct single-leg swap. Fastest, no privacy hop.
- `types=private`. Two legs through a privacy bridge, so deposit and payout are not linkable on-chain. Adds `anonymous`, `useXmr`, `rotatePayoutWallets` and the `inLeg*` / `outLeg*` filters.

Flow: [Get tokens](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/get-tokens) with `hasCex=true` → [Get quotes](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/get-quotes) → [Create exchange](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/create-exchange) → [track the order](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/get-order-details). `markup` works in both modes.

tags.name: Multi-Exchange
tags.description:
Create and track a group of swaps sharing one `multiId`.

- post the orders straight to Create multi exchange. There is no quote step and no `quoteId`
- Get multi quotes is optional, for showing rates first
- each order gets its own deposit address; poll [Get batch status](/api-reference/multi-exchange/get-batch-status) for every leg
- CEX standard and private only, no DEX in a batch

To fund the whole group in one transaction, see Bundler SOL or Bundler EVM. See the [multi-swap flow](https://docs.houdiniswap.com/developer-hub/swap-flows/multi-swap) for the full sequence.

tags.name: Bundler SOL
tags.description:
Fund a whole multi-exchange group with one Solana batch transfer.

- one call. Build batch transaction returns the transaction to sign and broadcast
- up to 10 deposits per batch; all orders share one source chain
- find batchable tokens with [Get tokens](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/get-tokens) and `hasBundler=true`
- nothing to submit back afterwards. Retry and recovery are EVM-only

See the [multi-swap flow](https://docs.houdiniswap.com/developer-hub/swap-flows/multi-swap) for the full sequence.

tags.name: Bundler EVM
tags.description:
Fund a whole multi-exchange group with one ERC-4337 UserOperation, submitted through the bundler.

- up to 20 legs per batch; all orders share one source chain
- find batchable tokens with [Get tokens](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/get-tokens) and `hasBundler=true`
- build the UserOp, then submit the signed result
- if a bundle fails: retry within 30 minutes, or recover stuck assets

See the [multi-swap flow](https://docs.houdiniswap.com/developer-hub/swap-flows/multi-swap) for the full sequence.

tags.name: On-chain DEX or Bridge
tags.description:
On-chain swaps signed and funded from the user's own wallet.

Flow: [Get tokens](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/get-tokens) with `hasDex=true` → [Get quotes](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/get-quotes) with `types=dex` → [Get token approval data](/api-reference/on-chain-dex-or-bridge/get-token-approval-data) → send it and poll [Check token allowance](/api-reference/on-chain-dex-or-bridge/check-token-allowance) → [Get next chain signature](/api-reference/on-chain-dex-or-bridge/get-next-chain-signature) → [Create exchange](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/create-exchange) → [Confirm DEX transaction](/api-reference/on-chain-dex-or-bridge/confirm-dex-transaction) → [track the order](/api-reference/private-and-standard-swaps/get-order-details).

- `slippage` applies to DEX only
- `markup` is not supported
